import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup

def get_h2_tags(url):
    """
    Fetches the content of the URL and extracts the text of all <h2> tags.
    """
    try:
        # Using a header to mimic a legitimate browser request
        headers = {
            "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/91.0.4472.124 Safari/537.36"
        }
        
        response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
        response.raise_for_status()  # Check for HTTP errors

        soup = BeautifulSoup(response.text, 'html.parser')
        
        # Extract text and strip whitespace
        h2_headers = [tag.get_text(strip=True) for tag in soup.find_all('h2')]
        
        return h2_headers

    except requests.exceptions.RequestException as e:
        print(f"Network error occurred: {e}")
        return []

if __name__ == "__main__":
    target_url = "https://example.com"
    tags = get_h2_tags(target_url)

    for i, tag in enumerate(tags, 1):
        print(f"{i}: {tag}")

import requests
import time
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup

def get_h2_tags(url):
    """
    Fetches the content of the URL and extracts the text of all <h2> tags.
    """
    try:
        headers = {
            "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/91.0.4472.124 Safari/537.36"
        }
        
        response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
        response.raise_for_status()

        soup = BeautifulSoup(response.text, 'html.parser')
        return [tag.get_text(strip=True) for tag in soup.find_all('h2')]

    except requests.exceptions.RequestException as e:
        print(f"Error fetching {url}: {e}")
        return []

if __name__ == "__main__":
    # List of URLs to scrape
    target_urls = [
        "https://example.com",
        "https://example.com" # Duplicated to demonstrate the loop/delay
    ]

    for index, url in enumerate(target_urls):
        print(f"Scraping: {url}")
        tags = get_h2_tags(url)
        
        for i, tag in enumerate(tags, 1):
            print(f"  {i}: {tag}")
            
        # Add a 2-second delay, but skip after the last request
        if index < len(target_urls) - 1:
            time.sleep(2)
